verdict.rationale: Riveter is a web research, scraping and enrichment platform, so adaptive crawling is a fair question for it. The pack never documents crawling that stops on its own once enough information has been gathered. The search_agent 'agent loop' and the max_credits spending cap are related features, not sufficiency-based adaptive stopping.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on adaptive crawling that automatically stops once enough information has been gathered to answer my query
